newsitem.title: UK: DDB BRISBANE RETAINS GOLD LOTTO ACCOUNT.
newsitem.headline: DDB BRISBANE RETAINS GOLD LOTTO ACCOUNT.

text.p: Advertising agency DDB Brisbane in Australia said on Wednesday it had retained the Golden Casket Corporation's Gold Lotto advertising business, valued at $6 million.
DDB International, part of Omnicom Group Inc, announced the account win in a statement released in London.
The portfolio, which contains four lottery games,is one of Queensland's largest and most sought after accounts.
Nineteen competitors pitched for the business, including Clemenger BBDO, George Patterson Bates and Mojo Partners.
DDB Brisbane said the account win meant it could strengthen its relationship with Gold Lotto.
